# Partners

## Who this is for

- Wallets & RPC providers on Sonic
- Relayers for privacy-entry gas abstraction
- Merchants exploring invoice / paygate flows
- Auditors reviewing bytecode and circuits

## Checklist before you ship

- [ ] Addresses match the current [verified contracts](../contracts) registry and signed release
- [ ] You run RPC / indexing you trust for production
- [ ] Modules you depend on are authorized on the shielded token
- [ ] Required verifiers exist on-chain before users hit them
- [ ] You tell *your* users what is private vs visible

## What we do not promise

- Custody
- Guaranteed liquidity or price floors
- Legal advice for your jurisdiction

Talk to us via [community channels](../resources/community). We do not negotiate partnerships in unsolicited DMs.
